papers.title: A NEW SPECIES OF MIMEUTERMES FROM THE GOLD COAST (ISOPTERA: NASUTITERMITINAE)
papers.venue: Proceedings of the Royal Entomological Society of London Series B Taxonomy

papers.title: A new species of Mimeutermes Silvestri and the imago of Nasutitermes diabolus (Sjöstedt) from Africa (Isoptera: Nasutitermitinae)
papers.venue: Proceedings of the Royal Entomological Society of London Series B Taxonomy
papers.abstract: A new species of Mimeutermes is described from imagos taken in Tanganyika. A key to the four species of Mimeutermes and a note on their distribution are included. The hitherto unknown imago of Nasutitermes diabolus is described from a unique male taken in Gabon.
